item.title: Full professor: 1 full professor position - Article 18, paragraph 1 of Law 240/2010 - PHIL-01/A - SPPEFF (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-16 12:00
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/PHIL-01 Filosofia teoretica

The University of Palermo calls a selection procedure to cover 1 position as university full professor of Theoretical Philosophy, pursuant to art. 18, paragraph 1, of Law 240/2010, at the Department of Psychological, Pedagogical, Physical Exercise and Educational Sciences.

item.title: Full professor: n.1 permanent position of Full Professor in the Faculty of Humanities, 11/HIST-02 – Modern History, academic discipline HIST-02/A - Modern History. (Sc. Norm. Sup. PISA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-21 16:00
Institution: Sc. Norm. Sup. PISA, Pisa E Sedi Della Scuola Normale Superiore
Field: History, philosophy, education, psychology / 11/HIST-02 Storia moderna

The functions to be carried out by the successful applicant include teaching activities to cover courses of the academic discipline HIST-02/A - Modern History, in the undergraduate and PhD courses, as well as other teaching activities within the same sector, in accordance with the Statute, as specified within the planning established on a yearly basis by the relevant academic authorities. The successful applicant will also be required to follow undergraduate degree and PhD theses, organise seminars and conferences, engage in research activities, also developing his/her own autonomous lines of research, in the field of Modern History, as outlined in the academic discipline description…
